articles.title: Gulf Tensions Ignite: Yemen's Houthis and U.S.-Iran Naval Clashes Raise Global Oil Prices
articles.description: Escalating conflict in the Gulf sees Yemen's Houthis striking four Saudi cities, wounding 70 and targeting oil installations. Concurrently, U.S. forces retaliate against Iranian tankers, reigniting global tensions. These events threaten to disrupt energy supplies and have driven oil prices up, impacting the global economy and political scene.

articles.title: Oil prices keep rising and weigh on Wall Street
articles.description: U.S. stocks fell in their return to trading from a three-day weekend after the latest fighting in the war with Iran pushed oil prices higher. The S&P 500 sank 0.6% Tuesday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.2%, and the Nasdaq composite slipped 0.3%. They felt pressure after the cost for a barrel of Brent briefly neared $99.50. More expensive oil has worsened worries about inflation and is giving extra heft to a couple of reports on inflation that are coming later this week. They will be the final updates the Federal Reserve hears on inflation before its meeting on interest rates next week.
